Hello Hassan, I can’t find your name on file and we are unsure if you were our client. Are you a friend of the last person who wrote a review? This came up right after and there are no details about your experience. 
If you were a client, please give us a call at 438-797-1575 and let us know your pet’s name and which service was provided.  We would be happy to resolve any issues with fairness.

I had a very disappointing experience with this service.

I booked an appointment for 2:30 PM to have my cat’s nails trimmed. I arrived early around 2:10 PM and was told her husband wasn’t there yet. I said I was completely fine waiting. She later contacted me and said she could take my cat, so I gave him to her. About 30 minutes later, she returned him to me.

When I got home, I noticed that his front nails had been trimmed, but his back nails were still very long. When I contacted her about it, she explained that my cat had been moving and that she did not want to cut too much. She also told me that she does not usually do the nails and said I could come back when her husband/partner was there so he could finish them.

I was confused because if she wasn’t comfortable completing the nail trim herself, I would have been completely fine waiting for the person who normally does it. Instead, I left believing the service had been completed.

After I complained, I was eventually refunded the $23. Unfortunately, I also received an insulting message with the refund, which I found very inappropriate and unprofessional.

I was also originally quoted $20 over the phone but was asked for $23 afterward without the higher price being communicated to me beforehand.

The nail trim itself was disappointing, but I was more disappointed by how my complaint was handled afterward. Based on my personal experience, I would not bring my cat back or recommend this service.

Our Coconut always jumps out of the car and runs straight up to the door with so much joy that we have not the slightest doubt she is in the best hands.. She comes back home happy and sleepy since there is always playtime and walks for her. We also used the grooming service and were more than happy! It’s amazing to have one place that can do it all and where our dog feels safe and happy to return as often as we need to.

The Team at Foxy and friends, Saint Antoine street Montréal, are amazing ! Several times over a four year period they have helped me and some people I recomended their service to, and they have  been receptive  and supportive, totally open armed, even in somewhat last minute situations. This proves beyond doubt that they have unimpeachable care for- and respect for- the furry four legged friends that sometimes need respite in difficult situations, that their humans sometimes face. I have nothing but praise for their work. I like to imagine that several cats are no doubt grateful also for their caring attention !
Our old dog Max hadn’t had a haircut in years. Foxy did an amazing job. He looks ten years younger!
Really fun way to get your dog to play with other dogs if you need baby sitting. Communication with the owner was great!

Worst customer service ever
Groomer shaver off a wart on the tail an 11 yr old dog and it caused a vet bill and meds and the mgr didn’t even offer to pay the bill when it was their fault, as they had been notified. So cheap & unprofessional!

🚩 RED FLAG — please read before booking🚩

Summary of our experience: Our dog’s hair was trimmed despite clear instructions not to cut it, part of a mole on her tail was accidentally cut during grooming (even though we asked that extra care be taken around that area), we were not informed of the injury at the time, the appointment ran over two hours late with little communication, and we took our dog to the vet afterward for assessment.

Based on our personal experience, I would not recommend this groomer.

We recently adopted a retired Mira dog and booked a grooming appointment so she could be cleaned up and comfortable in her new retirement life. We chose this groomer based on reviews and clearly communicated our requests both in the intake form submitted prior to the appointment and again in person.

We explicitly stated that we did not want her hair cut, only brushed, washed, and dried. We also informed them that our dog has a mole on her tail and asked that they be especially careful around that area.

Despite this, her hair was trimmed. In addition, the mole on her tail was cut during grooming with scissors, resulting in a skin injury. We were not contacted at any point during the appointment to inform us that this injury had occurred.

The appointment was scheduled from 4:00 to 6:00 pm. We understand delays can happen, however there was no proactive communication. When we arrived at 6:22 pm, no one answered the door. After calling twice, we were told our dog would be ready in 45 minutes to an hour. When we called again an hour later, we were told 8:30 pm. We had to initiate all follow-ups ourselves to receive updates.

When picking up our dog, the groomer showed me her tail and explained that one groomer had stepped out without informing the other about the mole. I was given a small bag containing Polysporin, bandages, and gauze.
No recommendation to see a veterinarian was made.
No compensation or discount was offered at the time of pickup.
Full payment was still accepted.

I was quite shocked in the moment and paid before fully processing the situation.

Once home, we called back to discuss what had happened. The only compensation offered was a refund of the taxes and tip — approximately $30 on a $150 bill. Additional offers included a free nail trim or dog-sitting day, which we declined, as we would not feel comfortable returning our dog to their care.

We had to take our dog to the vet. The vet bill came to $375.40 for the consultation and medication, and a follow-up appointment is still required.

Additional observations:

-  We were not allowed to see the inside of the premises; our dog was handed to us on the front porch.
- The interior smelled strongly of cigarette smoke, which was concerning in a pet-care setting.

This review reflects our personal experience and the reasons we would not return or recommend this groomer.
